original_finding_content.subject: Seller reports commission increase from 7.5% to 15% and logistics failures (OUT OF WINDOW — undated, likely 2018–2019)
original_finding_content.raw_text:
- **Finding ID:** F-X22
- **What:** Seller Nancy reports Kichink announced commission increase from 7.5% to 15% with monthly evaluations, and she must carry packages to collection centers because Kichink fails to pick them up.
- **Verbatim snippet:** "estoy con kichink pero le falta controlar mejor la logística, a veces tengo que llevar los paquetes a los centro de recolección porque no pasan por ellos y en este mes nos informan que aumenta el porcentaje de comisión, del 7.5% a 15%. Pero cada mes van evaluar las tiendas para obtener una mejor monto de comisión dependiendo de los resultados, el monto menor será del 8.5%"
- **Source:** https://e-commerce.terrabionic.mx/shopify/shopify-o-kichink/
- **source_type:** blog
- **verification_status:** blocked_url_index_verified
- **Date:** Accessed April 2026; page undated
- **Notes:** OUT OF WINDOW. Seller: Nancy (comment section). Commission figures: increase from 7.5% to 15%; minimum achievable rate 8.5% for evaluated stores. Content likely from 2018–2019 based on commission change timeline. Page not directly fetched; content verified from search engine snippets. Unclear whether figures are before or after payment processing fees.
